desc: The Lightweight Cookie Notice – Cookie Banner for Cookie Consent plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 1.19 This is due to the W3TC_DYNAMIC_SECURITY constant being hardcoded to a publicly known value. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to know the W3 Total Cache mfunc security key, which when W3 Total Cache is installed may allow arbitrary PHP code injection.

title: Openwave Webtop Media Transcoder does not enforce administrator-defined file type restrictions to restrict the file-types to be converted.
desc: Openwave Webtop Media Transcoder does not enforce administrator-defined file type restrictions to restrict the file-types to be converted. This may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience.

title: Seanime v3.7.0 to v3.10.3 contains an argument injection vulnerability reachable through improper authorization, allowing unauthenticated LAN or Tailnet clients to bypass the privi
desc: Seanime v3.7.0 to v3.10.3 contains an argument injection vulnerability reachable through improper authorization, allowing unauthenticated LAN or Tailnet clients to bypass the privileged mediastream settings guard by setting transcodeHwAccel to custom and supplying attacker-controlled decodeFlags and encodeFlags via the transcodeHwAccelCustomSettings field, which are appended verbatim to the ffmpeg argument vector. Attackers can trigger execution via the mediastream request and HLS playlist endpoints to achieve arbitrary file write and file truncation on the host as the user running seanime, with the injected input options also enabling potential arbitrary local file read and outbound data exfiltration through ffmpeg's protocol handlers.

title: LingGuo-Drama through commit 8a6924a contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any registered user to manage all accounts through the /admin/v1/admins API protecte
desc: LingGuo-Drama through commit 8a6924a contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any registered user to manage all accounts through the /admin/v1/admins API protected only by AuthAdminJWT. Attackers can self-register, read every account's bcrypt hash, reset the bootstrap administrator's password via PUT, raise their authority_id, and delete accounts.

title: LingGuo-Drama through commit 8a6924a contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows registered users to access other users' projects because projects.Get la
desc: LingGuo-Drama through commit 8a6924a contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows registered users to access other users' projects because projects.Get lacks an owner check. Self-registered attackers can iterate numeric IDs via GET, PUT and DELETE /admin/v1/projects/:id to read, overwrite, reassign or delete any user's short-drama projects.

title: Open WES through 1.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to modify other warehouses' stock records because GlobalGatewayFilter never en
desc: Open WES through 1.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to modify other warehouses' stock records because GlobalGatewayFilter never enforces auth_warehouse scoping. Attackers holding the menu permission can enumerate sequential IDs on freezeContainerStock and unfreezeContainerStock endpoints to freeze or unfreeze container stock in other warehouses.

title: fish-island-backend through commit 7c61b78 contains an unauthenticated server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to make the server fetch attacker-supp
desc: fish-island-backend through commit 7c61b78 contains an unauthenticated server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to make the server fetch attacker-supplied URLs via the url parameter of GET /api/web/parse. Attackers can target internal hosts, loopback services or cloud metadata endpoints through redirect-following OkHttp requests and read back page titles, meta descriptions and favicons.

title: Roncoo-pay through commit 9428382 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in F2FPayController.orderQuery that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve payment records by
desc: Roncoo-pay through commit 9428382 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in F2FPayController.orderQuery that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve payment records by supplying a trxNo parameter. Attackers can guess transaction numbers, a '7' prefix plus a snowflake ID, to obtain the full serialized payment record of any merchant.

title: AipexBase through commit 690adb9 contains a sql injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject SQL through the order_by and group_by fields of the /api/data/invoke endpoin
desc: AipexBase through commit 690adb9 contains a sql injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject SQL through the order_by and group_by fields of the /api/data/invoke endpoint. Attackers can supply subqueries or EXTRACTVALUE and UPDATEXML functions that bypass the SqlGuard denylist and row-level security, reading other users' rows and tables.

title: Arkon through 0.9.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in list_skill_versions that allows authenticated employees to read other departments' skill version metadata by b
desc: Arkon through 0.9.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in list_skill_versions that allows authenticated employees to read other departments' skill version metadata by bypassing the can_access_skill check. Attackers holding the default skill:read permission can request GET /api/skills/{slug}/versions for another department's skill to obtain version numbers, hashes, storage paths and changelogs.

title: Arkon through 0.9.2 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows authenticated employees to read and modify other departments' sources because by-id routes in app/rou
desc: Arkon through 0.9.2 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows authenticated employees to read and modify other departments' sources because by-id routes in app/routers/sources.py skip can_access_document. Attackers can call the plan, progress, PATCH, retry and approve-extraction routes with foreign source IDs to disclose derived wiki titles and summaries and alter ingestion state.

title: Arkon through 0.9.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in GET /api/wiki/graph that lets authenticated employees read other departments' wiki metadata by supplying a for
desc: Arkon through 0.9.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in GET /api/wiki/graph that lets authenticated employees read other departments' wiki metadata by supplying a foreign slug. Attackers with only wiki:read:own_dept permission can query get_neighborhood() without scope checks to obtain page slugs, titles, types and link edges up to depth 3.

title: tarteaucitron.js before 1.37.0 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to block visitor pages by supplying unescaped cookie names to coo
desc: tarteaucitron.js before 1.37.0 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to block visitor pages by supplying unescaped cookie names to cookie.purge. Attackers can plant a cookie from a sibling subdomain or inject a purgeBtn element with a catastrophic-backtracking data-cookie pattern that freezes the page when the purge button is clicked.

title: tarteaucitron.js before 1.37.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability because getElemAttr resolves 'data-' prefixed attributes while the https-only guard validates the unpre
desc: tarteaucitron.js before 1.37.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability because getElemAttr resolves 'data-' prefixed attributes while the https-only guard validates the unprefixed attribute. Attackers who can place markup, such as CMS authors, can add data-url with a javascript: URL beside a benign url to execute script in the site's origin via iframe src.

title: Netcore NR256CN through 1.5.140116 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach protected management CGI handlers by prefixing the
desc: Netcore NR256CN through 1.5.140116 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach protected management CGI handlers by prefixing the URI with a public route. Attackers can request paths prefixed with l7_web_auth.cgi or an .ico route to invoke protected management handlers without credentials.

title: Netcore NR256CN through 1.5.140116 contains a pre-authentication stack overflow vulnerability in the Boa web server's user_ok() function, which copies Basic-auth usernames with unb
desc: Netcore NR256CN through 1.5.140116 contains a pre-authentication stack overflow vulnerability in the Boa web server's user_ok() function, which copies Basic-auth usernames with unbounded strcpy() calls into 64-byte stack buffers. Unauthenticated attackers can send a username longer than 63 bytes to any protected /router/*.cgi route to crash the main Boa process or potentially execute code.

title: Netcore NR256CN through 1.5.140116 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the Boa web server's user_auth() function that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the
desc: Netcore NR256CN through 1.5.140116 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the Boa web server's user_auth() function that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the server via a malformed Authorization header. Attackers can send a Basic Authorization value lacking a colon, such as one decoding to a single character, to protected routes like /router/get_user_type.cgi to kill the main Boa process and deny management interface access.

title: WhaTicket Community through commit cf04795 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated agents to access other agents' tickets because ShowT
desc: WhaTicket Community through commit cf04795 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated agents to access other agents' tickets because ShowTicketService performs no ownership or queue checks. Attackers can supply another agent's ticket id to GET /tickets/:ticketId and /messages/:ticketId to read full message history and POST WhatsApp replies.

title: WhaTicket Community through commit cf04795 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to self-register as administrators via POST /auth/s
desc: WhaTicket Community through commit cf04795 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to self-register as administrators via POST /auth/signup. Attackers can omit the profile field or set it to admin, gaining user management, settings, and access to all tickets, contacts, messages, and WhatsApp connections.

title: 99AI through 4.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read other users' chat messages because querySingleChat lacks
desc: 99AI through 4.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read other users' chat messages because querySingleChat lacks an owner check. Attackers can send a fingerprint header to obtain a visitor JWT and iterate sequential chatId values to retrieve other users' message content and task data.

title: 99AI through 4.3.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the POST /api/chatLog/exportExcel route that allows unauthenticated attackers to export all users' chat logs.
desc: 99AI through 4.3.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the POST /api/chatLog/exportExcel route that allows unauthenticated attackers to export all users' chat logs. Attackers can send requests with controlled page, size, and optional email fields to download xlsx files containing usernames, emails, prompts, and AI answers.

title: Fuint through commit 57ec018 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated members to read other members' booking records by supplying arbitr
desc: Fuint through commit 57ec018 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated members to read other members' booking records by supplying arbitrary bookId values to /clientApi/book/myBookDetail. Attackers can iterate the auto-increment bookId to retrieve contact names, mobile numbers, in-store verification codes, service dates, stores and remarks.

title: LangChat through commit 2a6285a contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access REST controllers because no Sa-Token intercep
desc: LangChat through commit 2a6285a contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access REST controllers because no Sa-Token interceptor is registered. Attackers can query /api/v1/auth/users to read plaintext passwords, retrieve LLM provider API keys, create super-admin accounts, and modify or delete data.

title: yshop-crm through 2.1.3 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated sales users to access other users' customer records by supplying arbitr
desc: yshop-crm through 2.1.3 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated sales users to access other users' customer records by supplying arbitrary ids. Attackers can enumerate ids against the get, update, delete and do-open endpoints to read contact details, overwrite or delete customers, or release them into the public pool.

title: ChatOllama through commit 96c3ce5 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows remote attackers to access other users' private knowledge bases by supplyin
desc: ChatOllama through commit 96c3ce5 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows remote attackers to access other users' private knowledge bases by supplying sequential ids. Attackers can enumerate ids via GET /api/knowledgebases/{id} or the knowledgebaseId parameter of POST /api/models/chat to read metadata and retrieved document content.

title: OtterMind Nubase through 0.1.4 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access private bucket objects because /storage/v1/object/{bu
desc: OtterMind Nubase through 0.1.4 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access private bucket objects because /storage/v1/object/{bucketId}/{path} is treated as public for every HTTP method. Attackers knowing a tenant subdomain, bucket id and object path can download objects from private buckets and delete stored objects without an apikey or JWT.

title: WebVella ERP through 1.8.8 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to inject SQL through WHERE-clause text literals in the EQL query API.
desc: WebVella ERP through 1.8.8 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to inject SQL through WHERE-clause text literals in the EQL query API. Attackers can send crafted single-quoted literals to POST /api/v3/en_US/eql, escaping the unsanitized EqlBuilder SQL interpolation to read unauthorized entities, including user and role tables.

title: Niefy wx-api through 0.8.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to impersonate WeChat fans by supplying a raw openid cookie to fan-
desc: Niefy wx-api through 0.8.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to impersonate WeChat fans by supplying a raw openid cookie to fan-facing controllers. Attackers knowing a victim's openid can call /wxUser/getUserInfo and /wxUserTags endpoints to read nickname, phone, unionid and tags, and add or remove fan tags.

title: HUIZHI ChargeOS cloud through 3.0.9 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the hcp-mp PayController.xcxRecharge endpoint that allows attackers to modify any member's wal
desc: HUIZHI ChargeOS cloud through 3.0.9 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the hcp-mp PayController.xcxRecharge endpoint that allows attackers to modify any member's wallet balance without payment. Attackers can send requests with arbitrary amount and userId parameters to credit or reduce balances and consume charging services for free.

title: HUIZHI ChargeOS cloud through 3.0.9 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the hcp-mp MeController and OrderController that trusts client-supplied userId, op
desc: HUIZHI ChargeOS cloud through 3.0.9 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the hcp-mp MeController and OrderController that trusts client-supplied userId, openId and orderNumber parameters. Attackers can enumerate sequential member ids against endpoints like /me/getMemberBalanceByUserId and /order/orderDetail to read any member's wallet, credit, profile and charging orders.

title: data-platform-open through commit efeacd3 uses a hardcoded, publicly known default AES key in AesPasswordEncAndDecServiceImpl, allowing authenticated attackers to decrypt stored da
desc: data-platform-open through commit efeacd3 uses a hardcoded, publicly known default AES key in AesPasswordEncAndDecServiceImpl, allowing authenticated attackers to decrypt stored datasource passwords. Attackers can obtain ciphertext passwords from the datasource detail API, for example via cross-workspace IDOR, and decrypt them offline to recover plaintext database credentials.

title: Shaiwz data-platform-open through commit efeacd3 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated workspace members to access other workspaces'
desc: Shaiwz data-platform-open through commit efeacd3 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated workspace members to access other workspaces' datasources by numeric id. Attackers can send foreign sequential ids to /datasource/detail, /listSchemaTable, /tableDetail, /update or /delete to obtain JDBC credentials, enumerate database schemas, and modify or delete datasources.

title: qKnow through 2.4.3 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access /flyflow workflow integration endpoints permitted in Secu
desc: qKnow through 2.4.3 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access /flyflow workflow integration endpoints permitted in SecurityConfig. Attackers can POST sequential userId values to /flyflow/userById or call roleAll and deptListByParentDeptId to enumerate user phone numbers, roles, and department structure.

title: DataBuff ai-apm-web through 0.1.10 contains a hard-coded default credentials vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain administrator access using the built-in adm
desc: DataBuff ai-apm-web through 0.1.10 contains a hard-coded default credentials vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain administrator access using the built-in admin/Databuff@123 account. Attackers can POST these credentials to /webapi/api/v1/auth/login to obtain an administrator token and access all protected /webapi routes.

title: DataBuff ai-apm-web through 0.1.10 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge admin session tokens by using the hardcoded HMAC s
desc: DataBuff ai-apm-web through 0.1.10 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge admin session tokens by using the hardcoded HMAC secret in JwtTokenService. Attackers can sign a payload of admin and a future expiry with the default dev-secret to gain full administrative access to protected /webapi routes, including the Doris SQL query API.

title: WIMOOR through commit ec86736 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to impersonate any tenant and privilege level by sending an unsigned X-USERINFO
desc: WIMOOR through commit ec86736 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to impersonate any tenant and privilege level by sending an unsigned X-USERINFO header. Attackers reaching backend service ports directly, bypassing the gateway, can forge companyid and manager or admin usertype values to read and modify other tenants' orders, finance data, and Amazon seller authorizations.

title: Simple Admin Core through 1.8.7 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge super administrator tokens by using the hard-coded Au
desc: Simple Admin Core through 1.8.7 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge super administrator tokens by using the hard-coded Auth.AccessSecret in api/etc/core.yaml. Attackers can sign a JWT with the public secret and roleId claim 001 to gain full administrative control over users, roles, menus, API authorities, configuration and tokens.

title: Exrick XBoot through 3.3.4 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read user records of any department by ignoring role data scope.
desc: Exrick XBoot through 3.3.4 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read user records of any department by ignoring role data scope. Attackers can request GET /xboot/user/getByDepartmentId/{departmentId} with arbitrary department ids to retrieve usernames, real names, mobile numbers, emails and status.

title: Exrick XBoot through 3.3.4 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to evade role data-scope restrictions by sending openDataFilter=false.
desc: Exrick XBoot through 3.3.4 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to evade role data-scope restrictions by sending openDataFilter=false. Attackers can append this parameter to the department getByParentId or search endpoints to retrieve the entire organization's department tree and names outside their assigned scope.

title: WeRSS (we-mp-rss) through 1.5.3 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to run code via the template parameter of the public GET /rss/{
desc: WeRSS (we-mp-rss) through 1.5.3 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to run code via the template parameter of the public GET /rss/{feed_id} endpoint. Attackers can supply a non-built-in ext value and a {{=expression}} template whose object-subclass traversal bypasses the eval denylist to run OS commands as the service account.

title: IceCMS through 4.1.5 contains an unauthenticated sql injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject SQL through the num path parameter of /WebArticle/findarticlesby
desc: IceCMS through 4.1.5 contains an unauthenticated sql injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject SQL through the num path parameter of /WebArticle/findarticlesbynum. Attackers can append crafted SQL after the LIMIT clause concatenated into a MyBatis-Plus QueryWrapper to extract database contents via union-based or blind techniques.

title: IceCMS through 4.1.5 contains an unauthenticated sql injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject SQL by supplying a crafted num path parameter to /WebResource/fi
desc: IceCMS through 4.1.5 contains an unauthenticated sql injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject SQL by supplying a crafted num path parameter to /WebResource/findresourcebynum. Attackers can append SQL after the LIMIT clause concatenated via QueryWrapper.last() to extract database contents using union-based or blind techniques.

title: Magistrala through 1.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated workspace members to view, issue, and revoke other tenants' device certificates by
desc: Magistrala through 1.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated workspace members to view, issue, and revoke other tenants' device certificates by supplying foreign serials or entity ids. Attackers can call RevokeBySerial, RevokeAll, ViewCert, ListCerts, or IssueCert under their own workspace path to disconnect other tenants' devices, disclose certificates, and mint CA-signed certificates for their device ids.

title: Allegro Ralph through 20260902.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated staff users to bypass rack model permissions because RalphPermission skips
desc: Allegro Ralph through 20260902.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated staff users to bypass rack model permissions because RalphPermission skips checks for views without a queryset. Attackers can call DCAssetsView and SRRacksAPIView at /api/rack/<id> and /api/server_room/<id> to read asset hostnames, serials and management IPs, and to modify, move or create racks.

title: EFAK 5.0.0 through 5.1.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to read LLM provider API keys through the /api/model-config RE
desc: EFAK 5.0.0 through 5.1.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to read LLM provider API keys through the /api/model-config REST API. Attackers with any ROLE_USER account can query /api/model-config/page or /api/model-config/{id} to retrieve unmasked keys, enabling provider account access and incurred costs.

title: EFAK through 5.1.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to manage accounts because the /api/users endpoints lack administrat
desc: EFAK through 5.1.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to manage accounts because the /api/users endpoints lack administrator role checks. Attackers can send POST, PUT, or DELETE requests to UserController to grant themselves ROLE_ADMIN, create administrators, or delete users, gaining control of managed Kafka clusters.

title: APIPark through 1.9.7-beta contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated team managers to access other teams' services and applications by supplying thei
desc: APIPark through 1.9.7-beta contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated team managers to access other teams' services and applications by supplying their own team id in the team query parameter. Attackers can target service or app ids exposed by /api/v1/simple/services and /api/v1/simple/apps to read, modify, or delete other teams' services and applications via /api/v1/service/info and /api/v1/app endpoints.

title: Ekko Studio through 0.7.36 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated non-super_admin user to list and clear server-wide login lockouts via /api/a
desc: Ekko Studio through 0.7.36 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated non-super_admin user to list and clear server-wide login lockouts via /api/auth/locked-ips. Attackers can send DELETE requests without an ip parameter to invoke unlockAll(), disabling the login rate limiter during password guessing against super_admin accounts.

title: Antiword through 0.37 contains a stack out-of-bounds read vulnerability in vGet8PapInfo and vGet8ChrInfo in prop8.c because FKP run counts and grpprl offsets are not bounded.
desc: Antiword through 0.37 contains a stack out-of-bounds read vulnerability in vGet8PapInfo and vGet8ChrInfo in prop8.c because FKP run counts and grpprl offsets are not bounded. Attackers can supply a crafted .doc file with malicious FKP pages to read past the 512-byte stack buffer, crashing antiword or corrupting style parsing.

title: Antiword through 0.37 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in vGet8LstInfo in prop8.c caused by an inverted bounds check on the PlcfLst record count.
desc: Antiword through 0.37 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in vGet8LstInfo in prop8.c caused by an inverted bounds check on the PlcfLst record count. Attackers can supply a crafted Word 8 .doc file claiming up to 0xffff LSTF records in a tiny buffer, causing reads past the heap allocation that crash the process.

title: Faveo Helpdesk through 2.0.3 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows authenticated agents to read tickets in other departments via the getTooltip handler.
desc: Faveo Helpdesk through 2.0.3 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows authenticated agents to read tickets in other departments via the getTooltip handler. Attackers can enumerate sequential ticketid values on GET /ticket/tooltip to read ticket conversations, including customer personal data and internal agent notes.

title: Course-tencent-cloud through 2.0.1 contains an improper restriction of authentication attempts vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to brute force 6-digit SMS/email
desc: Course-tencent-cloud through 2.0.1 contains an improper restriction of authentication attempts vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to brute force 6-digit SMS/email verification codes, which are never invalidated or attempt-limited. Attackers who know a victim's phone or email can trigger a code and rotate source IPs against the password reset and verify login endpoints to take over accounts.

title: Tbed through 20240319 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to rename other users' images through the /admin/setImgFileName endpoint.
desc: Tbed through 20240319 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to rename other users' images through the /admin/setImgFileName endpoint. Attackers can supply a victim's imgname, exposed in public image URLs and album listings, to overwrite display names with attacker-chosen text attributed to the victim.

title: IceCMS through 4.1.5 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify, delete, or disable any account because /User/** is excluded fr
desc: IceCMS through 4.1.5 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify, delete, or disable any account because /User/** is excluded from the Shiro jwt filter. Attackers can send PUT requests to /User/updateUser to set a new password and role on any userId, including administrators, enabling full account takeover.

title: Cube-studio through 2026.09.01 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in myapp/views/view_pipeline.py that allows authenticated users to view or copy other project groups'
desc: Cube-studio through 2026.09.01 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in myapp/views/view_pipeline.py that allows authenticated users to view or copy other project groups' pipelines by id. Attackers can enumerate sequential pipeline ids via the web, log, monitoring, pod, and copy_pipeline endpoints to expose DAGs, cluster names, namespaces, Argo workflow ids, and pod names, or clone pipelines.

title: Cube-studio through 2026.09.01 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to stop, reset, clear or redeploy other users' notebooks a
desc: Cube-studio through 2026.09.01 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to stop, reset, clear or redeploy other users' notebooks and services by id. Attackers can pass sequential ids to lifecycle endpoints in view_notebook.py, view_inferenceserving.py and view_serving.py to delete pods and take production inference endpoints offline.

title: ClickVisual through 1.1.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the /api/v2/reports handlers that allows authenticated low-privileged users to access ClickHouse instanc
desc: ClickVisual through 1.1.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the /api/v2/reports handlers that allows authenticated low-privileged users to access ClickHouse instances they were not granted. Attackers can iterate the instance-id parameter in ReportSourceDatabases, ReportSourceTables, ReportTableColumns and WhereCheckRun to enumerate schemas and infer row counts of restricted tables.

title: ZR.Admin.NET through 3.8.2 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to manipulate the ORDER BY clause by supplying a crafted PagerInfo.Sort query
desc: ZR.Admin.NET through 3.8.2 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to manipulate the ORDER BY clause by supplying a crafted PagerInfo.Sort query parameter to the shared ToPage paging helper. Attackers holding the system:user:list permission can inject subquery or CASE expressions via GET /system/user/list to extract database contents such as stored credentials through blind techniques.

title: AIHelms through 0.1.25 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in apps/api/v1/efficiency.py that allows authenticated low-privileged users to bypass efficiency:read and effi
desc: AIHelms through 0.1.25 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in apps/api/v1/efficiency.py that allows authenticated low-privileged users to bypass efficiency:read and efficiency:write permission checks. Attackers can query routes like /cost/detail, /top-users and /budget to read organization-wide AI spend, and can modify suggestion statuses or generate reports.

title: REBUILD through 4.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in TaskCommentController.commentList that allows authenticated low-privileged users to read task comments witho
desc: REBUILD through 4.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in TaskCommentController.commentList that allows authenticated low-privileged users to read task comments without project membership checks. Attackers can supply the id of a task in a private project to the /project/comments/list endpoint to retrieve its comment content and attachment references.

title: Steedos Platform through 3.0.15-beta.51 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read other tenants' report definitions by querying the rep
desc: Steedos Platform through 3.0.15-beta.51 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read other tenants' report definitions by querying the reports object. Because objectql's callAdapter skips space filtering for enable_space_global objects on find/findOne, attackers can call GET /api/v1/reports to disclose report names, descriptions, and object and field API names.

title: Piranha CMS through 12.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Piranha.Manager LanguageApiController that allows any authenticated manager user to list, create, edi
desc: Piranha CMS through 12.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Piranha.Manager LanguageApiController that allows any authenticated manager user to list, create, edit and delete site languages without the granular Language, LanguageAdd, LanguageEdit or LanguageDelete permissions. Attackers can call the manager/api/language Get, Save and Delete actions directly to remove languages and reassign sites to the default, affecting localized content instance-wide.

title: Safing Portmaster before 2.2.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unprivileged local processes to force updates by calling the POST /api/v1/updates/from-url
desc: Safing Portmaster before 2.2.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unprivileged local processes to force updates by calling the POST /api/v1/updates/from-url endpoint registered with api.PermitAnyone. Attackers can supply an attacker-controlled index URL that bypasses version checks and auto-apply settings, installing older Safing-signed releases carrying previously fixed vulnerabilities.

title: Chaskiq through 2.0.3 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to fetch arbitrary URLs via the createUrlUpload GraphQL mutation.
desc: Chaskiq through 2.0.3 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to fetch arbitrary URLs via the createUrlUpload GraphQL mutation. Attackers can submit internal URLs, including cloud instance metadata endpoints, through POST /graphql and retrieve the full response via the returned ActiveStorage blob URL.

title: Chaskiq through 2.0.3 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to make the server fetch arbitrary URLs via the url parameter of th
desc: Chaskiq through 2.0.3 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to make the server fetch arbitrary URLs via the url parameter of the /oembed endpoint. Attackers can target loopback, private, or cloud-metadata addresses through FetchLinkCardService, which follows redirects and skips TLS verification, to read internal page titles and descriptions.

title: waynboot-mall through 2.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to send arbitrary email by calling the anonymously mapped /callbac
desc: waynboot-mall through 2.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to send arbitrary email by calling the anonymously mapped /callback/email endpoint. Attackers can POST caller-supplied subject, content, and recipient to EmailController.sendEmail, sending messages from the operator's SMTP account for phishing, spam, and mail quota exhaustion.

title: waynboot-mall through 2.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to cancel any member's pending order via the /callback/order/unpai
desc: waynboot-mall through 2.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to cancel any member's pending order via the /callback/order/unpaid endpoint. Attackers can submit predictable orderSn values, built from epoch seconds and a sequential counter, to auto-cancel unpaid orders and manipulate product stock levels.

title: Waynboot-mall through 2.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge orders by calling the internal /callback/order/submit mes
desc: Waynboot-mall through 2.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge orders by calling the internal /callback/order/submit message-queue callback. Attackers can supply arbitrary userId, addressId and cart ids in the order JSON to create orders for any member, expose stored shipping details, clear carts, and decrement stock.

title: SiteServer SSCMS through 7.4.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in ChannelsController that allows site-scoped administrators to access other sites' channels by supply
desc: SiteServer SSCMS through 7.4.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in ChannelsController that allows site-scoped administrators to access other sites' channels by supplying foreign channel IDs. Attackers with Channels permission on one site can read and overwrite another site's channel names, file paths, templates, link URLs, and custom fields, breaking multi-site isolation.

title: BeikeShop through 2.0.0.31 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the markAsShipped handler of RmaController that allows authenticated customers to modify ot
desc: BeikeShop through 2.0.0.31 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the markAsShipped handler of RmaController that allows authenticated customers to modify other customers' returns. Attackers can submit sequential RMA ids to the account/rmas/{id}/mark_as_shipped endpoint to overwrite courier names and tracking numbers and mark approved returns as shipped.

title: ChatWiki through 2.9.6 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to access another tenant's form filters by supplying arbitrary for
desc: ChatWiki through 2.9.6 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to access another tenant's form filters by supplying arbitrary form_id values. Attackers can send sequential form_id values to getFormFilterList, getFormFilterInfo and updateFormFilterSort to read filter rules and overwrite another tenant's filter sort order.

title: ThinkAdmin think-plugs-admin through 1.0.81 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows non-super administrators to read and overwrite other administrato
desc: ThinkAdmin think-plugs-admin through 1.0.81 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows non-super administrators to read and overwrite other administrators' file records via admin/file.edit. Attackers holding the admin/file.edit node can request or POST a target id with columns like xurl, hash, or uuid to view download URLs, tamper records, or reassign ownership.

title: FastBee through 2.1.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to access other users' device groups because GroupCon
desc: FastBee through 2.1.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to access other users' device groups because GroupController queries lack owner checks. Attackers, including self-registered users, can supply sequential group IDs to read, overwrite, reassign, rewrite device associations of, or delete other users' groups.

title: 53AIHub through 0.5.3 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite any enterprise's profile by sending PUT requests to /api/en
desc: 53AIHub through 0.5.3 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite any enterprise's profile by sending PUT requests to /api/enterprises/:id. Because UpdateEnterprise only enforces checks when IS_SAAS is true, attackers can enumerate sequential enterprise IDs and overwrite logos, display names and branding for defacement and phishing.

title: Engineercms through 2.0.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in AttachController.Attachment that allows unauthenticated attackers to download project image and video at
desc: Engineercms through 2.0.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in AttachController.Attachment that allows unauthenticated attackers to download project image and video attachments. Attackers can request known or derived /attachment/* paths for .jpg, .png, .bmp, or .mp4 files, which are served before casbin, owner, or admin checks.

title: Risesoft Digital-Infrastructure through 9.6.11 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the log module DownloadController that allows authenticated users to export any ten
desc: Risesoft Digital-Infrastructure through 9.6.11 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the log module DownloadController that allows authenticated users to export any tenant's personnel directory. Attackers can supply another tenant's tenantId to exportLoginXLS or exportNotLoginXLS to obtain XLSX files with names, login names, organization paths, mobile numbers, and emails.

title: ChronoFrame through 1.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the server/api/wizard/ handlers that allows unauthenticated attackers to reconfigure already configured
desc: ChronoFrame through 1.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the server/api/wizard/ handlers that allows unauthenticated attackers to reconfigure already configured instances. Attackers can POST to /api/wizard/storage to activate an attacker-controlled S3 or OpenList provider, redirecting uploads and storage reads, and overwrite site and map settings.

title: Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in DownloadAttachment that allows authenticated users to access private media by
desc: Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in DownloadAttachment that allows authenticated users to access private media by supplying arbitrary content IDs. Attackers can enumerate sequential post_content ids via the /v1/attachment endpoint to obtain signed download URLs for other users' private, friend-only and following-only images, videos and attachments.

title: BuildAdmin through 2.3.9 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated backend administrators to modify other administrators' profiles via th
desc: BuildAdmin through 2.3.9 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated backend administrators to modify other administrators' profiles via the id parameter. Attackers holding the routine/adminInfo/edit permission can overwrite avatar, nickname, email, mobile and motto fields, including a super administrator's email and mobile.

title: PickMall lilishop through 5.0.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated buyers to read other buyers' invoice records because ReceiptSer
desc: PickMall lilishop through 5.0.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated buyers to read other buyers' invoice records because ReceiptServiceImpl.getDetail performs no ownership check. Attackers can supply another buyer's receipt id to GET /buyer/trade/receipt/{id} to obtain invoice titles, taxpayer identification numbers, order numbers, member ids and member names.

title: SurveyKing before 1.13.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to download any stored file by id through GET /api/public/preview/{att
desc: SurveyKing before 1.13.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to download any stored file by id through GET /api/public/preview/{attachmentId}. Attackers who know or derive time-ordered snowflake file ids can bypass shared, owner, and project checks in FileServiceImpl.loadFile to read private survey attachments and respondent uploads.

title: MrDoc through 1.1.1 contains a missing object-level authorization vulnerability in the ImportLocalDoc API that allows authenticated users to modify other users' documents and proje
desc: MrDoc through 1.1.1 contains a missing object-level authorization vulnerability in the ImportLocalDoc API that allows authenticated users to modify other users' documents and projects. Attackers can send PUT requests with arbitrary sort_data document ids to publish private drafts and reparent documents, or POST with arbitrary top_doc ids to inject documents.

title: Misaka Danmu Server through 2.8.9 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access audit, diagnostics, data-check, scan-index and hea
desc: Misaka Danmu Server through 2.8.9 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access audit, diagnostics, data-check, scan-index and health routes under /api/ui lacking the get_current_user dependency. Attackers can read audit logs with login IPs, server logs and environment paths, delete episode rows, clear media-server mappings, and wipe audit history.

title: Misaka Danmu Server through 2.8.9 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary configuration keys via the unprotected PO
desc: Misaka Danmu Server through 2.8.9 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary configuration keys via the unprotected POST /api/ui/config-history/rollback endpoint. Attackers can set the ipWhitelist key to their own /32 address, or alter trustedProxies and webhookApiKey, to access every protected endpoint as the administrator.

title: FastapiAdmin through 3.0 contains a hard-coded JWT signing secret in backend/app/config/setting.py that allows low-privileged users to forge tokens impersonating the superuser.
desc: FastapiAdmin through 3.0 contains a hard-coded JWT signing secret in backend/app/config/setting.py that allows low-privileged users to forge tokens impersonating the superuser. Attackers can register via the unauthenticated /api/v1/system/user/register endpoint, log in, and forge an HS256 token keeping their session_id but naming the superuser in user_name to gain superuser privileges.

title: FastapiAdmin through 3.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain sessions for any user by abusing unprotected auto-login end
desc: FastapiAdmin through 3.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain sessions for any user by abusing unprotected auto-login endpoints. Attackers can list users via /api/v1/auth/auto-login/users, mint a superuser auto-login token, and exchange it for a JWT session to gain full administrative control.

title: DooTask through 1.9.66 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in WebSocketDialog::checkDialog() that skips the membership check for dialogs with group_type 'okr'.
desc: DooTask through 1.9.66 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in WebSocketDialog::checkDialog() that skips the membership check for dialogs with group_type 'okr'. Authenticated users can supply the dialog_id of OKR comment dialogs to msg__list, msg__one, or msg__send* endpoints to read and inject messages.

title: bbs-go through 4.4.6 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the /api/login/google_one_tap endpoint that allows remote attackers to log in as other users by submitting G
desc: bbs-go through 4.4.6 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the /api/login/google_one_tap endpoint that allows remote attackers to log in as other users by submitting Google ID tokens issued to any OAuth client. Attackers operating their own Google OAuth client can capture a victim's Google-signed ID token and replay it, since the aud claim is never checked, to obtain an authenticated session as the victim's Google-linked account.

title: sshportal through 1.19.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the management shell 'key show' command that allows authenticated non-admin users to obtain decrypted bac
desc: sshportal through 1.19.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the management shell 'key show' command that allows authenticated non-admin users to obtain decrypted backend private SSH keys. Attackers can request predictable key names like 'default' or 'host' to retrieve private keys and connect directly to backend hosts, bypassing ACLs and session recording.

title: NexoPOS through 6.2.4 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read accounting transaction records via GET /api/fields/{resource}/{i
desc: NexoPOS through 6.2.4 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read accounting transaction records via GET /api/fields/{resource}/{identifier}. Attackers can request transaction field classes like ns.entity-transaction with sequential ids to retrieve names, values, account ids, and descriptions without nexopos.read.transactions permission.

title: OpenBMB StaffDeck through 0.5.6 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator session tokens using the hard-coded def
desc: OpenBMB StaffDeck through 0.5.6 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator session tokens using the hard-coded default app_secret. Attackers can sign an HMAC-SHA256 token for the seeded 'admin' user in 'tenant_demo' to gain full tenant administration, including stored model and channel credentials.

title: Helical Insight through 7.0.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated viewers to read files outside the solution directory via the path parameter of /getE
desc: Helical Insight through 7.0.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated viewers to read files outside the solution directory via the path parameter of /getExternalResource. Attackers can supply parent-directory segments to read any readable file with an allowed extension such as js, json, or html, bypassing per-resource access control.

title: Helical Insight through 7.0.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated viewers to inject SQL through unescaped report parameter values sent to /executeData
desc: Helical Insight through 7.0.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated viewers to inject SQL through unescaped report parameter values sent to /executeDatasource. Attackers can supply crafted Numeric or String placeholder values that bypass the broken SqlDetect guard to read unexposed tables and modify data in the report's data source.

title: ZKEACMS through 4.4 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge REST API JWT bearer tokens using a hard-coded HMAC-SHA256 signing
desc: ZKEACMS through 4.4 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge REST API JWT bearer tokens using a hard-coded HMAC-SHA256 signing key in JwtBearerDefaults.cs. Attackers can sign a token with the Name claim set to 'admin' to call ApiAuthorize endpoints, modifying articles and products and reading form submissions.

title: Aureus ERP through 1.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated API users to create or move records into disallowed companies by supplying a forei
desc: Aureus ERP through 1.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated API users to create or move records into disallowed companies by supplying a foreign company_id. Attackers can submit create or update requests to plugin REST API endpoints such as partners, sales, or inventories to break multi-company data segregation.

title: Distributor before 2.3.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows Contributor-level users to invoke external connection AJAX actions intended for manage_options u
desc: Distributor before 2.3.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows Contributor-level users to invoke external connection AJAX actions intended for manage_options users. Attackers can call dt_verify_external_connection with a chosen endpointId and url to send stored connection credentials to attacker-controlled servers, or abuse dt_begin_authorization to create connections.

title: abp-next-admin 10.2.0 through 10.6.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the LINGYUN.Abp.AIManagement module that allows authenticated users to access oth
desc: abp-next-admin 10.2.0 through 10.6.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the LINGYUN.Abp.AIManagement module that allows authenticated users to access other users' AI chat conversations by supplying their ConversationId. Attackers holding the Chat permission can call ChatAppService.GetListAsync or SendMessageAsync with a victim's ConversationId GUID to read chat messages and inject messages into that conversation.

title: IoTSharp through 3.6.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to read other tenants' data because Customers and Devices API h
desc: IoTSharp through 3.6.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to read other tenants' data because Customers and Devices API handlers do not scope queries to the caller's tenant. Attackers can self-register through the anonymous AccountController.Create endpoint and supply other tenants' GUIDs to read customer contact details, device inventories and device attribute telemetry.

title: 10up Distributor before 2.3.2 contains a PHP object injection vulnerability that allows Contributor-level users to instantiate PHP objects by double unserializing distributed post
desc: 10up Distributor before 2.3.2 contains a PHP object injection vulnerability that allows Contributor-level users to instantiate PHP objects by double unserializing distributed post meta. Attackers can store a serialized PHP string as meta, which set_meta() in includes/utils.php unserializes on the destination site, storing attacker-defined objects whose impact depends on loaded gadget classes.

title: HestiaCP before 1.10.5 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows non-ROOT_USER administrators to perform write actions while impersonating the protected ROOT_USER
desc: HestiaCP before 1.10.5 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows non-ROOT_USER administrators to perform write actions while impersonating the protected ROOT_USER account. Attackers can log in via the loginas parameter and POST to /add/cron/, because the read-only flag is never checked, causing crond to run their commands as the protected administrator's system account.

title: Webreaper Damselfly through 4.5.3 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access all /api/* routes because controller authorization
desc: Webreaper Damselfly through 4.5.3 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access all /api/* routes because controller authorization attributes are commented out. Attackers can send PUT /api/users with Admin roles to create administrator accounts, or POST /api/users to reset any user's password, gaining full control.

title: 10up Distributor before 2.3.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ajax_push() that allows Contributor-level multisite users to publish posts on other network sites.
desc: 10up Distributor before 2.3.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ajax_push() that allows Contributor-level multisite users to publish posts on other network sites. Attackers can use the dt-push nonce with a chosen connection id and postStatus to create draft or published posts on sites they cannot access.

title: Umbraco CMS before 17.7.1 and 18.2.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated clients to connect to the backoffice PreviewHub and BackofficeHub Si
desc: Umbraco CMS before 17.7.1 and 18.2.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated clients to connect to the backoffice PreviewHub and BackofficeHub SignalR hubs. Attackers can complete the SignalR negotiate step and receive refreshed notifications that disclose content keys, including unpublished content, and reveal editorial activity timing.

title: Xiaozhi-esp32-server-java through 6.1.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain valid device WebSocket tokens by requesting
desc: Xiaozhi-esp32-server-java through 6.1.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain valid device WebSocket tokens by requesting /api/device/ota with any MAC address. Attackers can open a victim device's WebSocket channel to read private role system prompts, write conversation history, consume LLM/STT/TTS credentials, and overwrite device metadata.

title: smart-sso through 2.1.1 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the /login handler that allows unauthenticated attackers to steal OAuth2 authorization codes by supplying an unva
desc: smart-sso through 2.1.1 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the /login handler that allows unauthenticated attackers to steal OAuth2 authorization codes by supplying an unvalidated redirectUri parameter. Attackers can send crafted /login links to users with active SSO sessions, then redeem stolen codes at /oauth2/access_token with any valid client credentials to obtain victims' access tokens.

title: TDuck Survey Form through 5.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to read other owners' raw form settings via GET /user/form/setting/{
desc: TDuck Survey Form through 5.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to read other owners' raw form settings via GET /user/form/setting/{key}. Attackers can supply the 8-character form key from a public fill link to obtain the form write password, owner notification e-mail, and WeChat openIds.

title: O2OA through 10.0.2-ce contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in x_processplatform_assemble_surface that allows authenticated users to download attachments from other works
desc: O2OA through 10.0.2-ce contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in x_processplatform_assemble_surface that allows authenticated users to download attachments from other works. ActionDownloadWithWork and ActionDownloadWithWorkStream never verify that the requested attachment id belongs to the referenced work or draft, so any visitable work or owned draft can be supplied. Attackers who know an attachment UUID can request it through jaxrs/attachment/download/{id}/work/{workId} to read documents attached to other users' processes.

title: FilePress through 3.0.1 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to inject SQL into ORDER BY clauses via the unvalidated asc parameter.
desc: FilePress through 3.0.1 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to inject SQL into ORDER BY clauses via the unvalidated asc parameter. Attackers can use blind boolean or time-based subqueries in dzz/pichome/library/filelist.php and dzz/collection/filelist.php to extract database rows including administrator credential hashes.

title: CoAI (Chat Nio) through 4.0.0 contains an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in the generation and article archive download endpoints via the hash query parameter.
desc: CoAI (Chat Nio) through 4.0.0 contains an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in the generation and article archive download endpoints via the hash query parameter. Attackers can supply ../ sequences in hash to download any readable .tar.gz or .zip file, including other users' generated archives.

title: WHartTest through 2.8.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to connect to the /ws/ui/web/ and /ws/ui/actuator/ WebSocket endpoints
desc: WHartTest through 2.8.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to connect to the /ws/ui/web/ and /ws/ui/actuator/ WebSocket endpoints because UiAutomationConsumer accepts every connection. Attackers can register an actuator with a client-supplied id to intercept other users' test-case payloads, receive broadcast step results, and spoof results and screen frames into victim sessions.

title: Oqtane Framework through 10.2.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in SettingController that allows a site administrator to read another co-tenant site's private settin
desc: Oqtane Framework through 10.2.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in SettingController that allows a site administrator to read another co-tenant site's private settings. Attackers with the Administrators role on one site can request another site's entityId through their own alias to retrieve stored SMTPPassword and SMTPClientSecret values.

title: Mall4cloud through 4.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated merchants to read other shops' buyer shipping addresses via the multisho
desc: Mall4cloud through 4.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated merchants to read other shops' buyer shipping addresses via the multishop OrderController getOrderAddr handler. Attackers can enumerate auto-increment orderAddrId values in GET /m/order/order_addr/{orderAddrId} requests to obtain consignee names, mobile numbers, addresses and post codes platform-wide.

title: DataCap through 2025.1.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in BaseController.getInfoForPath that allows authenticated users to read other users' datasource
desc: DataCap through 2025.1.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in BaseController.getInfoForPath that allows authenticated users to read other users' datasources, snippets and dashboards by numeric id. Low-privileged attackers can enumerate auto-increment ids on the source, snippet and dashboard endpoints to retrieve serialized datasource host, port, username and cleartext passwords.

title: AllData through 0.7.1 contains an unauthenticated JDBC injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to open arbitrary database connections by supplying jdbcUrl and jdbcDriv
desc: AllData through 0.7.1 contains an unauthenticated JDBC injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to open arbitrary database connections by supplying jdbcUrl and jdbcDriverClass values to the data-dts /jobJdbcDatasource/test endpoint. Attackers can supply a MySQL JDBC URL with allowLoadLocalInfile=true pointing to an attacker-controlled server to read arbitrary files from the data-dts host.

title: netdisk-fast-download through 0.4.8 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve donated netdisk credentials via the /v2/rando
desc: netdisk-fast-download through 0.4.8 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve donated netdisk credentials via the /v2/randomAuth endpoint in ParserApi. Attackers can repeatedly call the endpoint and decrypt the encryptedAuth blob using the hard-coded AES key nfd_auth_key2026 to recover other users' cloud-drive cookies, tokens, or passwords.

title: roncoo-education through 25.0.0-RELEASE contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to cancel or continue payment on other users' ord
desc: roncoo-education through 25.0.0-RELEASE contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to cancel or continue payment on other users' orders. Attackers can supply another user's order number to the pay cancel or continue endpoints to close pending orders or read course ids and prices.

title: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ArticleConsole that allows authenticated authors to access other authors' articles by omitting per-author
desc: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ArticleConsole that allows authenticated authors to access other authors' articles by omitting per-author ownership checks. Attackers can query the console articles status endpoint to list other authors' drafts, probe draft content via the k parameter, and use push2rhy to push others' articles to the Rhythm community.

title: PKP Open Journal Systems through 3.5.0-5 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows journal or subscription managers to access other journals' subscript
desc: PKP Open Journal Systems through 3.5.0-5 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows journal or subscription managers to access other journals' subscriptions by supplying arbitrary subscription ids. Attackers can enumerate sequential ids through editSubscription to view subscriber details and use updateSubscription to reassign subscriptions to their own journal, revoking victims' access.

title: Jeepay through 3.2.9 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated merchant users to delete other merchants' division receivers by exploiting
desc: Jeepay through 3.2.9 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated merchant users to delete other merchants' division receivers by exploiting an ownership check on the wrong column. Attackers holding ENT_DIVISION_RECEIVER_DELETE who own a receiver group whose id matches a victim's receiver id can delete the victim's profit-sharing receiver.

desc: Huly Platform through 0.7.432 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to merge arbitrary persons by calling the mergeSpecifiedPersons account RPC. desc: Jpom through 2.11.12 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in SshFileController that allows authenticated workspace users to access SSH hosts belonging to other workspaces by supplying foreign SSH asset ids. desc: eladmin through 2.7 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows department-scoped user managers to modify or delete accounts outside their data scope because write handlers skip department checks. desc: PlayEdu through 2.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the CourseController that allows authenticated students to access department-restricted courses by omitting the department visibility check.
